type BreakerOptions struct{Failures int; Successes int; HalfOpenCalls int; OpenFor time.Duration; PerModel bool}
func Budget(limit float64, opts ...BudgetOptions) Middleware
type BudgetOptions struct{Cost func(usage schemaflux.Usage, model string, provider string) schemaflux.Cost; AllowUnpriced bool}
func Bulkhead(limit int, opts ...BulkheadOptions) Middleware
type BulkheadOptions struct{Reject bool}
func Cache(opts ...CacheOptions) Middleware
type CacheEvent struct{Hit bool; Coalesced bool; Key string; Tenant string; DataPolicy string; Bypassed bool}
type CacheOptions struct{TTL time.Duration; Store CacheStore; OnEvent func(CacheEvent)}
type CachePartition struct{Tenant string; DataPolicy string}
type CacheStore interface{Get(ctx context.Context, key string) (schemaflux.Response, bool); Set(ctx context.Context, key string, resp schemaflux.Response, ttl time.Duration)}
type Capabilities struct{NativeJSONSchema bool}
func Chain(base schemaflux.Provider, mws ...Middleware) schemaflux.Provider
func CircuitBreaker(opts ...BreakerOptions) Middleware
type DecisionOptions struct{Floor float64; Model string; NoFailover bool}
func Decisions(generator schemaflux.Provider, decider schemaflux.Provider, options DecisionOptions) schemaflux.Provider
func Fallback(alternates []Route, opts ...FallbackOptions) Middleware
type FallbackOptions struct{On []schemaflux.Kind; AllowSchemaDegradation bool; Primary Capabilities}
func Func(name string, complete func(context.Context, schemaflux.Request) (schemaflux.Response, error)) schemaflux.Provider
func Hedge(after time.Duration) Middleware
type Middleware func(next schemaflux.Provider) schemaflux.Provider
func RateLimit(n int, per time.Duration, opts ...RateLimitOptions) Middleware
type RateLimitOptions struct{Burst int; Reject bool}
func Redact(opts ...RedactOptions) Middleware
type RedactOptions struct{NoBuiltins bool; Patterns map[string]*regexp.Regexp; Marker string; Func func(string) string}
func Retry(opts ...RetryOptions) Middleware
type RetryOptions struct{Retries int; BaseDelay time.Duration; MaxDelay time.Duration}
type Route struct{Provider schemaflux.Provider; Capabilities Capabilities; Model string}
func WithCachePartition(ctx context.Context, p CachePartition) context.Context
func Wrap(next schemaflux.Provider, complete func(ctx context.Context, req schemaflux.Request, next schemaflux.Provider) (schemaflux.Response, error)) schemaflux.Provider
